build_mae_pretrain_head: build an MAEPretrainHead module with a loss config, norm_pix flag, and patch size
patchify_images: split a batch of images into non-overlapped patches using MAEPretrainHead patchify method
unpatchify_patches: combine non-overlapped patches back into images using MAEPretrainHead unpatchify method
construct_reconstruction_target: construct a normalized reconstruction target from images using MAEPretrainHead construct_target method
compute_mae_loss: compute the masked reconstruction loss given predictions, targets, and a mask tensor
